items.name: drake-sit-2
items.prompt: Keep this exact same dragon: the same huge dark green armoured lizard drake, same head, same scales, same pale bony back spikes, same long thick tail, same proportions, side view facing right. Change only his pose and mood: he has given up the fight and sits down quietly on his haunches like a tired old dog, front legs straight, his long tail curled round in front of his feet, his head lowered, eyes half shut and gentle, looking down at a small rusty tin tea mug standing on the ground in front of his front claws. All his colours a little paler and greyer, as if his fire has gone out, a little grey ash dusted on his back, no glow anywhere. The whole dragon fully in the picture with space all round. Solid flat magenta background, nothing else.
